Class Gui

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.gui.Gui
public class Gui extends javafx.application.Application
Main JavaFX application class that serves as the central controller for the GUI. Manages the lifecycle of different game screens, coordinates between various controllers, and handles the flow of game states from initial connection through final results. Implements the Application interface to initialize the JavaFX runtime.
